plan.notes: Transcribed from the official CRC 'Journalism AA-T Degree' program map, Catalog Year 2026-2027, published September 24, 2026 (mapmaker.losrios.edu/Maps/7870/PublishedPdf). GE Pattern: Cal-GETC. Map states Total Units 62; verified = 15+16+15+16 = 62. SEMESTER 3 STRUCTURE: the map prints 'JOUR 411 College Media Production II or' followed by the JOUR 351 row; with the 15-unit semester header, this is a single or-choice (JOUR 411 or JOUR 351), not two separate 3-unit rows (which would sum to 18). JOUR 411 prerequisite: JOUR 410 (advisories: JOUR 300, 355, 404, or PHOTO 302). JOUR 351 also appears here as the alternative to JOUR 411. JOUR 410 prerequisite per map: ENGL C1000 (not sequenced; carried under external_prereqs). JOUR 310 also listed as RTVF 300 (cross-listed). AREA 5 SCIENCE PAIR: Semester 1 offers 'CalGETC Area 5A-Physical Science or 5B-Biological Science'; Semester 4 offers the Area 5 science not taken in Semester 1 (map text garbled as '5B-Biological Science or 5B-Biological Science (not taken in Semester 3)'; intent is to complete the 5A/5B pair), plus 5C lab. CalGETC Area 4 footnote: 'Select a non-JOUR course to meet IGETC Area 4' (map prints IGETC). List A (minimum 6 units; one 3-unit slot in Semester 2, one in Semester 3): JOUR 320, COMM 311 (prerequisite ENGL C1000), COMM 363, ECON C2002 or ECON C2001, ENGL C1001 (prerequisite ENGL C1000), PHOTO 302, POLS C1000, POLS 302, STAT C1000E (4 units; already required in Semester 2). List A suggestions: ENGWR 302 (Sem 2), JOUR 320 / POLS 301 (Sem 3), JOUR 351 / COMM 363 and ECON 302 / ECON 304 (Sem 4 electives). Semester 1 Area 1A: map recommends meeting with a counselor. Elective units are determined by the number needed to total 60 units for graduation; refer to Course Number for the appropriate course level.
